## Heartbeat watchdog (dead man's switch)
Alerts Discord when a job that should run on a schedule **stops** running. Error workflows can't catch that, because nothing errors.

1. Edit **Heartbeats to watch**: one line per job, with how many minutes it may go quiet.
2. Paste your Discord webhook URL in **Post to Discord**.
3. Save and switch the workflow to **Active** (the memory only works in active mode).
4. At the END of each job, call the Production URL of **Heartbeat ping** with `?name=<job>`:
   cron: `... && curl -fsS "https://YOUR-N8N/webhook/heartbeat?name=nightly-backup"`
   n8n: add an HTTP Request node (GET) as the last step.

You get one alert when a heartbeat goes missing and one when it comes back. If n8n itself goes down it can't alert you: for that, run the Python version on another machine.
